release_claim.statement: Haxe.Go is a pre-1.0 beta for pinned, application-qualified portable workloads on the admitted toolchain, platform, and operation/member surface.
release_claim.default_disposition: Any unlisted module operation, member, platform, architecture, native API, error path, or trust model is excluded from the admitted release scope.

semantic-diff-supported.meaning: Named deterministic behavior is compared between Haxe --interp and generated Go, which also compiles, passes go test, and runs.

compile-go-test-run-supported.meaning: The named target-sensitive behavior compiles, passes go test, runs on Go, and matches an explicit expected contract without claiming interpreter parity.

compile-only.meaning: The named surface compiles or cross-builds, but runtime and semantic support are not admitted.

experimental.meaning: The named surface is implemented and tested in some lanes but remains outside the admitted release contract.

compatibility-only.meaning: The input or behavior is retained for compatibility and does not define a separate semantic product or release admission.

excluded.meaning: The named surface is deliberately unsupported by the admitted release scope.

go.patch_policy: exact latest available patch pins, refreshed deliberately from the official Go release history

platforms.qualification: Canonical beta evidence platform; release evidence must record the exact hosted runner image and resolved toolchain patches.
The quality workflow runs macos-latest, but the architecture and image are not frozen as a release compatibility promise.
exclusions: No stable runner-image or architecture compatibility promise

platforms.qualification: Representative examples cross-build; no release runtime, race, or security matrix is admitted.
exclusions: Runtime and security evidence

platforms.qualification: Representative examples cross-build; the moving macos-latest lane is tracked separately.
exclusions: Pinned runtime and security evidence

platforms.qualification: Representative examples cross-build; Windows runtime behavior is not in the admitted beta matrix.
exclusions: Runtime, path, process, race, and security evidence

platforms.qualification: No implicit operating-system or architecture support is inferred.
exclusions: All combinations not named above

presets.qualification: Default product path. Only operations and members explicitly admitted below are part of the beta claim.
exclusions: Unlisted portable operations and members

presets.qualification: Supported compatibility policy preset, not a second semantic product and not an independent native-authority claim.
exclusions: Independent semantic-product or stable native-API admission

operations.qualification: Deterministic typed control flow within the snapshot and semantic-diff corpus.
exclusions: Unlisted compiler AST forms

symbols: Haxe class construction and instance dispatch
Haxe enum construction and pattern matching
operations.qualification: Covered typed construction, dispatch, pattern matching, capture, and function-value behavior only.
exclusions: Unlisted reflection or dynamic construction behavior

operations.qualification: Haxe-thrown exception carrier behavior; foreign Go panic behavior remains a separate native contract.
exclusions: Blanket native Go panic normalization

surfaces.scope: Named core collection and text members

operations.qualification: Core indexed and iterator behavior exercised by the named contract.
exclusions: Array members not named by the operation inventory

operations.qualification: Named string members including out-of-range charCodeAt behavior.
exclusions: Unlisted Unicode normalization or locale behavior

operations.qualification: Only members exercised by the cross-stdlib contract.
exclusions: Unlisted StringTools members

surfaces.scope: Named data, serialization, and standard collection members

operations.qualification: Deterministic parse/stringify shapes in the named JSON contract.
exclusions: Backend-specific Dynamic carrier representation

operations.qualification: Named byte-buffer operations and bounds behavior.
exclusions: Unlisted encoding and streaming members

operations.qualification: Core operations for the map/list shapes exercised by the contract.
exclusions: Blanket admission of every haxe.ds member

operations.qualification: Only operations exercised by option_date_path and linked direct contracts.
exclusions: Unlisted timezone, locale, and filesystem normalization behavior

operations.qualification: Some and None construction plus exhaustive switch matching exercised by option_date_path.
exclusions: Unlisted enum reflection or Dynamic carrier behavior

operations.qualification: Path joining and parsed dir/file/ext fields exercised by option_date_path.
exclusions: Unlisted platform-specific path normalization behavior

operations.qualification: Construction from the literal POSIX path shape exercised by option_date_path.
exclusions: Unlisted platform-specific path normalization behavior

operations.qualification: Closed-world public declarations and the exact Type members exercised by the extended contract.
exclusions: Open-world registration and unlisted Type members

operations.qualification: Named dynamic-field operations on covered runtime shapes.
exclusions: Unlisted reflection and carrier representations

operations.qualification: On admitted linux-amd64 terminals, reads one byte without newline, suppresses host echo, restores terminal state, preserves redirected EOF, and performs requested staged echo exactly once.
exclusions: Non-admitted runtime hosts
Unicode codepoint or terminal key-sequence interpretation
Terminal signal-character policy beyond the exercised byte contract

operations.qualification: Text content reads plus missing, directory, and permission failure categories on the admitted platform.
exclusions: Unlisted encoding, special-file, and platform-specific behavior

operations.qualification: Text content writes plus directory and permission failure categories on the admitted platform.
exclusions: Atomic replacement, durability, locking, and unlisted encodings

operations.qualification: Line, empty-line, long-line, and EOF separation for admitted local commands.
exclusions: Arbitrary binary streaming and hostile child protocols

operations.qualification: Named pipe write/read, positive pid, and close behavior from the error-semantics contract.
exclusions: Signals, process groups, and platform-specific handles

operations.qualification: Zero and nonzero exit state remains distinct from EOF and launch failure.
exclusions: Signal-to-exit-code portability outside the admitted platform

operations.qualification: Detached process construction intentionally throws on this target.
exclusions: Detached child processes

operations.qualification: Complete Haxe 4.3.7 surface over a local temporary tree, including metadata size, canonical existing paths, and absolute paths that need not exist.
exclusions: Symlink races, network filesystems, permissions beyond named cases, and watcher APIs

surfaces.scope: Admitted portable synchronization, foreground-thread, event-loop, and pool operations

operations.qualification: Named primitive behavior has interpreter parity; supported Go race evidence covers ownership, visibility, per-waiter condition generations, and missed/duplicate wakeup regressions.
exclusions: Scheduler fairness, arbitrary foreign-goroutine attachment, and operations not named by the contract

operations.qualification: Get, set, clear, and main/worker isolation have interpreter parity. Runtime churn proves completed portable workers and compiler-owned detached go.Go.spawn callbacks release logical identity and TLS values on return and native-panic unwind; supported Go race, checkptr, vet, and staticcheck lanes exercise the boundary.
exclusions: Automatic lifecycle discovery for goroutines created outside portable Thread and compiler-owned go.Go.spawn boundaries

operations.qualification: Named foreground-thread and event-loop behavior has interpreter parity; deterministic supported-Go stress proves pool admission/shutdown exactly once, failed-worker replacement, cancellation cleanup, wakeup deadline recomputation, and bounded portable identity state.
exclusions: Exact scheduler fairness, concurrent ElasticThreadPool.maxThreadsCount mutation, and arbitrary foreign-goroutine lifecycle discovery

surfaces.scope: HTTP, TCP, UDP, TLS, timeout, and cleanup surfaces pending network audit

operations.qualification: Loopback semantic contracts exist; cancellation, timeout, cleanup, proxy, and hostile-peer closure remains open.
exclusions: Broad production HTTP client support

operations.qualification: Loopback and target-sensitive smokes exist; cross-platform timeout, cancellation, TLS, and cleanup evidence remains open.
exclusions: Broad production network and TLS support

operations.qualification: Typed snapshots and runtime smokes exist, but the governed native capability matrix is not complete.
exclusions: Stable or complete Go-native collection/error API admission

operations.qualification: Go-specific goroutine and channel lifecycle behavior, including closed-versus-empty receive and native close/send panics, is tested; true native select and the complete public native capability contract remain open.
exclusions: Stable Go concurrency authoring contract

operations.qualification: The named typed extern forms work for covered fixtures; broad callbacks, generics, unsafe shapes, and public API stability remain open.
exclusions: Stable admission of the full extern grammar

symbols: Compiler use with trusted Haxe source and locked dependencies
operations.qualification: The admitted beta assumes reviewed source and repository-controlled or otherwise trusted dependencies.
exclusions: Treating the compiler as a sandbox

symbols: Compiler use as a sandbox for untrusted Haxe source
operations.qualification: Compiler-managed source, runtime, report, metadata, extra-file, and package-staging destinations are confined, but Haxe macros, dependencies, plugins, and explicitly selected child tools execute with host authority; the compiler is not a sandbox for adversarial source.
exclusions: Untrusted or adversarial source compilation
Concurrent hostile mutation of the output filesystem

symbols: Deterministic local Haxelib package and isolated install
operations.qualification: Local deterministic construction and isolated install are gated, but hosted same-SHA assets are a separate release prerequisite.
exclusions: Published artifact availability and immutability

symbols: Published checksummed same-SHA Haxelib release assets
operations.qualification: The current beta-baseline publication gate is not complete.
exclusions: Claiming a validated published beta artifact before its release Beads close

portable_stdlib.rule: Module evidence never admits every member. Release admission comes only from the operation/member inventory in surfaces.

trust_assumptions.statement: Application Haxe source, build metadata, extern metadata, and dependency source are reviewed or otherwise trusted.
Repository tooling is installed from the committed npm lock and vendored Reflaxe provenance passes its offline verification.
Admitted file and process operations run on the canonical platform against application-controlled paths and child commands.
Network, HTTP, TLS, cancellation, and hostile-peer behavior are not part of the admitted beta operation surface.

known_blockers.scope: Network, HTTP, socket, timeout, cancellation, and cleanup closure
